payload.title: Freeze candidate, development, and scoreboard manifests
payload.description:
## Scope

Deterministically create disjoint partition manifests with documented seeds, class counts, sampling rationale, source-use history, and exact normalized-text duplicate exclusions across partitions. Scoreboard labels are only available to final scoring. Commit manifests before optimization or collection.

## Definition of done

Specs reject ID and text-hash leakage, preserve partitions across reruns, report class counts, and prevent policy-selection code from loading scoreboard labels. Historical holdouts are explicitly identified as previously used.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Freeze candidate, development, and scoreboard manifests
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given candidate, development, and scoreboard rows share an exact normalized-text duplicate
    When manifests are prepared
    Then the duplicate is excluded or preparation fails before any model call
```
